notes: This portable C++ TCK case unpublishes an adapter-configured ordinary interaction class through the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API, then requests publication state through the IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. The interaction-publication NULL report is exact; the accompanying directed-publication report is checked against its MIM-defined NULL or populated shape without asserting a cross-service side effect beyond this case's mapped requirement. Provider library, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and names remain adapter-supplied; the case uses no vendor hooks or DDM region APIs.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unpublishInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass) = 0
